bio: This building, almost cube-like in shape with large floor-to-ceiling windows that offer breathtaking views of the beautiful surrounding countryside, is striking for its modern, contemporary design, with a delightful outdoor space that is perfect for alfresco dining. Originally from Puglia, talented owner-chef Carmela Straniero fell in love with the Langhe having spent time working in England and Italy. Her refined and highly personalised cuisine fully respects culinary traditions and is prepared using top-quality local ingredients....
